summary: DevOps-learning Session 9 Cache & Release Frontend completed. Covered cache matrix for index.html/runtime-config/hashed assets; verified ETag revalidation and 304; fixed SPA fallback so missing assets return 404; explained release A/B, lazy-loaded chunk failures, assets-first HTML-last deployment, old asset retention and rollback; differentiated browser/CDN/service-worker caches; and covered CDN stale HTML debugging, targeted purge/invalidation, and cache-policy prevention.
